description: Simple USB-to-UART interface board. CH340 provides full-speed USB to TTL UART conversion, powered from a 3.3V rail generated by XC6206 from USB 5V input. The board exposes TXD and RXD as the UART interface, uses CH340 in TTL mode, and requires the external 12MHz crystal topology of the CH340G-style variant.

verification_assertions.desc: Ground unification: CH340 ground and XC6206 ground must share one common ground net.
3.3V domain unification: XC6206 output must power both CH340 VCC and V3 in 3.3V supply mode.
Critical net isolation: USB 5V input, 3.3V rail, GND, USB D+, USB D-, UART TXD, UART RXD, XI, and XO must all reside on mutually distinct nets.
Unified ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
USB 5V input rail feeding XC6206 must carry Power electrical attribute.
3.3V output rail generated by XC6206 must carry Power electrical attribute.
USB D+ and D- must form a valid differential pair and must not be shorted together.
UART TXD and RXD must not be tied to the same net.
CH340 XI/XO must connect to an external crystal with load capacitors to ground on both sides.
R232 must remain floating in TTL UART mode.
